title: Salvia miltiorrhiza Bge. processed with porcine cardiac blood alleviates cerebral ischemia reperfusion injury through activating PPARgamma/NF-kappaB pathway via suppressing arachidonic acid metabolism.
authors: Zhou, Shikang; Jiang, Wenye; Sun, Zhihu; Zhang, Jinyun; Zhang, Tian; Ma, Bingyan; Liu, Chanming; Zhang, Yi; Zhang, Li; Yan, Xiaojing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药炮制品对脑缺血再灌注损伤的保护机制，涉及PPARgamma/NF-kappaB通路和分子对接，但核心是药物作用而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅分子对接作为辅助验证。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Salvia miltiorrhiza Bge. (DS) processed with porcine cardiac blood (PCB-DS) is primarily used to treat cerebral ischemia, in accordance with the traditional principles of the Menghe Medical School. Studies demonstrated that PCB-DS was superior to DS in ameliorating cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury (CIRI). This effect was related to the modulation of brain inflammation. However, the underlying mechanism and material basis responsible for PCB-DS's superior efficacy over DS in improving CIRI require further investigation. AIM OF THE STUDY: To investigate the mechanism and material basis of PCB-DS superiority over DS in ameliorating CIRI. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The pharmacological activities of PCB-DS and DS were compared by the middle cerebral artery occlusion-reperfusion (MCAO/R) model. Proteomics and metabolomics were used to explore the potential mechanisms underlying PCB-DS's greater efficacy than DS in reducing CIRI. Based on the results, the PPARgamma signaling pathway and arachidonic acid (AA) metabolism pathway were analyzed. Subsequently, the brain-penetrating components were analyzed using UPLC-Q-TOF/MS. Finally, molecular docking was performed between proteins related to the PPARgamma signaling pathway and active components to confirm the material basis for PCB-DS's superior efficacy over DS. RESULTS: Compared to DS, PCB-DS better alleviated CIRI by improving neurobehavioral scores, lowering infarct volume, ameliorating brain histopathology, and decreasing oxidative damage indicators. Proteomic analysis revealed that the mechanism underlying PCB-DS and DS was also strongly associated with the regulation of the PPAR signaling pathway. WB results further indicated that PCB-DS more effectively reversed the expression levels of NLRP3, p-NF-kappaB, and inflammation-related concentrations vs. DS group (p < 0.05). The metabolomics analysis revealed that the impact of PCB-DS and DS was closely related to AA metabolism. PCB-DS better improved the level of AA and 15d-PGJ2 in rat brain vs. DS group (p < 0.05). The brain-penetrating components demonstrated that PCB-DS significantly elevated the concentrations of salvianolic acid B and 9''-methyl salvianolate B vs. DS (p < 0.05). Molecular docking further validated that these two components bind strongly to key targets such as PPARgamma, NLRP3, p-IKBalpha, and p-NF-kappaB. CONCLUSION: The superior effect of PCB-DS over DS in CIRI was to protect brain from inflammation through activating PPARgamma/NF-kappaB pathway via suppressing AA metabolism. The elevated levels of 9''-methyl salvianolate B and salvianolic acid B may contribute to this enhanced effectivity.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：丹参（Salvia miltiorrhiza Bge.，DS）经猪心血炮制后（PCB-DS）主要用于治疗脑缺血，符合孟河医派的传统理论。研究表明，PCB-DS在改善脑缺血再灌注损伤（CIRI）方面优于DS。该效应与调节脑部炎症有关。然而，PCB-DS相较于DS在改善CIRI方面疗效更优的潜在机制和物质基础仍需进一步研究。研究目的：探讨PCB-DS优于DS改善CIRI的机制和物质基础。材料与方法：通过大脑中动脉闭塞-再灌注（MCAO/R）模型比较PCB-DS和DS的药理活性。采用蛋白质组学和代谢组学探讨PCB-DS较DS减轻CIRI疗效更佳的潜在机制。基于结果，分析了PPARγ信号通路和花生四烯酸（AA）代谢通路。随后，利用UPLC-Q-TOF/MS分析入脑成分。最后，对PPARγ信号通路相关蛋白与活性成分进行分子对接，以确认PCB-DS优于DS疗效的物质基础。结果：与DS相比，PCB-DS通过改善神经行为学评分、降低梗死体积、改善脑组织病理学及降低氧化损伤指标，更好地减轻了CIRI。蛋白质组学分析显示，PCB-DS和DS的作用机制也与PPAR信号通路的调节密切相关。WB结果进一步表明，与DS组相比，PCB-DS更有效地逆转了NLRP3、p-NF-κB的表达水平及炎症相关浓度（p < 0.05）。代谢组学分析显示，PCB-DS和DS的作用与AA代谢密切相关。与DS组相比，PCB-DS更好地改善了大鼠脑中AA和15d-PGJ2的水平（p < 0.05）。入脑成分分析表明，与DS相比，PCB-DS显著提高了丹酚酸B和9''-甲基丹酚酸B的浓度（p < 0.05）。分子对接进一步验证了这两种成分与PPARγ、NLRP3、p-IκBα和p-NF-κB等关键靶点具有强结合力。结论：PCB-DS优于DS在CIRI中的效应是通过抑制AA代谢激活PPARγ/NF-κB通路，从而保护大脑免受炎症损伤。9''-甲基丹酚酸B和丹酚酸B水平的升高可能有助于增强这种效应。
